verdicts.reason: The two candidates look pixel-identical. Both have the same failures: the 'FUN GROUP' brand text is blown up so it is almost as big as the headline, and it sits right on top of the busy bike and bunny watercolour, which is a collision and hurts legibility. The bunny-on-bike illustration is cropped on both sides, so the basket and wheels are cut off. A leaf sprig is clipped at the right edge. The small headline floats over a large empty band at the top.
